heading: Federal Reserve banks as depositories
lead: Any Federal Reserve Bank 1 which is requested to do so by the Bank may act as its depository, or as its fiscal agent, and the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System shall exercise general supervision over the carrying out of these functions.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Another section 562(c)(5) of Pub. L. 101–513 is set out as a note under section 2293 of this title.
